whatAreFillings.title: What Are Dental Fillings?
whatAreFillings.description: Dental fillings are restorative treatments used to repair teeth damaged by cavities, minor fractures, or wear. After removing the decayed portion of the tooth, the affected area is filled with a durable material to restore its strength and function.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Dental Fillings Near Me

items.question: How long do dental fillings last?
items.answer: Dental fillings can last many years, depending on the material used, oral hygiene, and regular dental check-ups.

items.question: Are dental fillings painful?
items.answer: Modern filling procedures are generally comfortable. Local anesthesia is used when necessary to minimize discomfort.

items.question: How long does a dental filling appointment take?
items.answer: Most dental filling procedures are completed within 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the size and number of cavities.

items.question: When do I need a dental filling?
items.answer: If you have tooth decay, small cavities, minor cracks, or worn teeth, your dentist may recommend a filling.

items.question: What is the cost of dental fillings in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the type of filling material and the size of the cavity. A consultation provides an accurate treatment estimate.

items.question: Are tooth-colored fillings better than silver fillings?
items.answer: Composite tooth-colored fillings provide a natural appearance, bond well to the tooth, and preserve more healthy tooth structure.
